outputs.headline: False: 5G towers do not spread coronavirus
outputs.summary: There is no scientific evidence to support the claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus or cause an increase in COVID-19 cases.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, leading to a rise in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G technology was installed.
outputs.what_is_true: COVID-19 is a disease caused by a virus, not by 5G mobile technology. Numerous scientific and health organizations have confirmed there is no link between 5G and the spread of the coronavirus.
evidence_against: Full Fact states there is no evidence that 5G is harmful to people's health.
AP News rated as false the claim that maps show a correlation between COVID-19 cases and 5G service.
AFP Fact Check rated as false the claim that COVID-19 is bacterial and linked to 5G.
outputs.sources_spoken: Full Fact, AP News, and AFP Fact Check
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, causing an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G technology was installed. This is false. COVID-19 is a disease caused by a virus, not by 5G mobile technology. Numerous scientific and health organizations have confirmed there is no link between 5G and the spread of the coronavirus. We are very sure about this. This information comes from fact-checking organizations like Full Fact, AP News, and AFP Fact Check, who have all debunked similar claims.
card_lines: COVID-19 is a virus, not caused by 5G
